stops.detail: We are very pleased to welcome you on the website of our municipality St. Peter-Ording. This site was created for you, for people who live and work in our beautiful community, who were born, raised or newly moved here, who enrich us. We are 4,000 inhabitants: inside. Tourism characterizes our region and the number of day visitors exceeds our own population on summer days with over 20,000 guests per day. We know that.
